📜 Privacy Policy & Terms

Nihonify (漢字学習) · v6.7 · Created by Zishan & Its Team

Last updated: November 2026

1. Information We Collect

When you create a Nihonify account, we store your email address, name, age, city/country, learning level, study goal, daily target, and Japanese learning progress (Kanji mastery, daily streak, SRS queue, custom sets, and JLPT mock scores) securely using Google Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore.

2. How We Use Your Data

Your data is used strictly to sync your study progress across sessions, personalize your Japanese level and daily goal, verify your email, and protect your account with single-device security. We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third-party advertisers.

3. Data Security & Local Storage

All communication uses HTTPS encryption, strict Firestore server-side rules, and verified email authentication. Offline study data is cached locally on your device so you can practice even without internet.

4. Account & Data Deletion

You can reset your study progress anytime from the top menu. To permanently delete your account and cloud profile, contact the Nihonify team at zishan41965@gmail.com.

Last updated: November 2026

1. Educational Purpose

Nihonify (漢字学習) is a Japanese language learning platform for Hiragana, Katakana, Radicals, and JLPT N5–N1 Kanji practice. Content is provided for educational and self-study purposes.

2. Account & Single-Device Fair Use

Each account requires a verified email address and is intended for personal use on one active device at a time. Signing in on a second device automatically signs out the previous device.

3. VIP Access & Redeem Codes

VIP redeem codes are single-use and permanently linked to the account that redeems them. Attempting to tamper with client storage, bypass locks, or abuse the service may result in account suspension.

4. Updates & Contact

Features and study content may be updated over time to improve learning quality. For support or feedback, contact zishan41965@gmail.com.
